phase3f_constraint: No migration or authority transfer approved by this review.
conclusion: Domain documents are navigational owners for bounded responsibility sections. DATA_CONTRACTS.md, META_CONTRACTS.md, WORLD_MODEL.md and PERCEPTION.md retain their existing authority. The retained full-scope links prevent partial migration from falsely implying complete coverage. No new normative owner or God File is recommended.

existing_risks.risk: Cognitive governance, decision and implemented feedback can grow together; retain explicit ownership links to META_CONTRACTS and DATA_CONTRACTS.
World identity, authored structure and topology are adjacent; keep execution and perception authority external.
Physical policy and independent LOD overview can accumulate separate solver and coordinator responsibilities; do not assert a shared coordinator is implemented.
Visual and auditory candidate mathematics should stay distinguished from implemented projection and permission rules.
Player interpretation and presentation need explicit boundary with formal execution; do not introduce UI authority.

cross_document_coupling: Keep only necessary cross-domain references; detailed contracts remain authoritative
